top_choice_rationale: P006 recognizes a mature, consequential and complementary political-economy programme linking political incentives, institutions, state capacity and fiscal policy. Its scope requires disciplined wording, but the proposed trio maps credibly to a sustained contribution across theory and empirical work.
recusal_note: I am an institutional colleague of John Hassler, Per Krusell and Timo Boppart at Stockholm University, in a different department. No direct professional relationship with the P006 laureates is apparent from the supplied profile.
